lines: THE VILLAIN DRAWN TO SELL TOYS

segments.text: For twenty-three years, no other comic company could legally put the word zombie on a cover. Marvel owned it.

segments.text: Two years later, in 1975, the trademark office actually approves it. By then the series is already winding down.

segments.text: Doesn't matter — the trademark's live. Any other publisher wanting a zombie comic has to dance around the word entirely. Different title. Different cover language. Anything but the Z-word.
